methodology.physics: Release-mode legacy bridge, 2,000 separated dynamic bodies, 240 fixed 60 Hz steps; includes record decode/encode and finite-value validation.
methodology.scriptReload: Rhai editor language analysis of a representative gameplay source, 1,000 warm iterations; p95 reported.
methodology.assetImportCore: Decode/hash/compress a deterministic 16 MiB source buffer 20 times; p95 reported. Browser image decode is intentionally excluded.
methodology.export: Headless deterministic web export of the platformer reference project against the production dist.
methodology.artifactSize: On-disk bytes of available native executable and production web assets.
